instruction: HARD GATE (R-8 canary). Build a real createRouter + createMemoryHistory + RouterProvider test over a SYNTHETIC route that uses the production validateBoardSearch and applyFilterSearch on a trivial probe component. Do not mount the real board route. Assert: (1) a filter change writes a LITERAL 'assignee=u1,u2' into location.searchStr with no %5B anywhere — this is the OQ-2 proof; (2) history.back() restores the prior filter state (AC-4); (3) garbage search params still mount (AC-5); (4) clearTaskId navigation keeps assignee and labels and drops taskId (AC-6/R-2 end-to-end pin). If assertion (1) fails, STOP the run and escalate — do NOT fall back to JSON encoding.
acceptance: location.searchStr contains the literal substring 'assignee=u1,u2'
location.searchStr contains no '%5B'
history.back() restores the previous assignee value
a route with ?assignee=&labels=,,&taskId= mounts without throwing
after clearTaskId navigation the searchStr retains assignee and labels and has no taskId

instruction: Implement the controlled hook exactly per change_plan.md sections 3.1-3.7. Add optional 4th options arg {controlled, onControlledChange}. Derive `filters` with useMemo during RENDER (never an effect) so a controlled value is truth on the first render — this is FR-9/AC-3. Funnel all four mutators through one private `commit` helper; onControlledChange is the ONLY write path for assignee/labels. Change the mirror effect to persist `filters` (the effective memo) instead of internal state — that one word resolves DR-13. Simplify the hydrate effect to setInternalFilters(readStoredBoardFilters(projectId)) on [projectId]. Export boardFiltersStorageKey and readStoredBoardFilters. Do NOT add a controlled-to-internal sync effect. Include the required INVARIANT code comment: at most one commit per event handler. Append a new describe block to the test file; DO NOT edit the two existing tests.
acceptance: the two pre-existing tests are byte-identical and still pass (FR-11)
no useEffect appears on the controlled-value to filters path (FR-9/NFR-1)
the AC-3 render probe records the filtered count on renders[0] and on every render
storage is overwritten by the controlled value, never the reverse (FR-13)
updateFilter on status/priority/dueDate does not call onControlledChange
the INVARIANT comment about one commit per handler is present in the source
